Title: Custom Translation capability of Text Translator

Body.Content:
Custom translation capability in Translator Text Cognitive Service is now Generally Available. With custom translation capability, customers can use human-translated content to build a translation custom system that can better handle specific writing styles, industry expressions and vocabulary.

The general availability price for custom translation is 4x the cost of standard translation and will go into effect on February 1st, 2019.
